source_en: Your left panel has a new crack. Gvantsa Edisherashvili, political science.
Four people every six minutes. I've counted since the barriers went up.
Because nobody else is. If nobody records it, it didn't happen.
No one. Reports get lost; my notebooks don't.
Some people cross twice. Same face, minutes apart. Nobody stops them.
So is half of what I've written down. Two notebooks of it.
A man in a gray coat, Tuesday. [[whisper:He didn't know his own name]] the second time.
Check my stamp. Then check my face. Everyone forgets the face.
